subject: How to fix some parameters to specific values for FIPC (Fixed item parameter calibration)?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: How to fix some parameters to specific values for FIPC (Fixed item parameter calibration)?
parts:
Hi Phil,

Can I know How to fix some parameters to specific values for do 'FIPC' for the new form in test equating? (If I already know some item parameters in context of common item test equating setting.)

I saw some manual for pars='values' and mirt.model() function, but I can't understand it.

Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to fix some parameters to specific values for FIPC (Fixed item parameter calibration)?
parts:
What does FIPC stand for? You right to use the pars = 'values' approach though. Just locate the parameters you want fixed to changed their values, and set their $est element to FALSE to fix them at those values.

Phil
